head: four teacher-mode logits plus one tanh continuous steering output; deterministic native eight-channel decode
loss: unweighted mode cross-entropy + Chase-only steering squared error averaged over all callbacks, with coefficient 1
callback_order: chronological within each match; fixed frozen match order; each training callback once per epoch; no balancing
hidden_state: reset only at match boundaries; detach gradient every training chunk without changing hidden-state values
checkpoint_selection: minimum teacher-forced validation loss; no test access for selection
evaluation_device: CPU, one thread, same selected checkpoint for both conditions
exact_action_agreement: all eight decoded native channels equal frozen float32 analog and uint8 button targets exactly; no tolerance
additional_tolerant_action_agreement: all buttons exact and all analog absolute errors <= 0.000001; reported separately
test_policy: only after both models selected; one final evaluation suite per selected model, both conditions; no test tuning
student_forced_scope: replace only prior-mode one-hot and prior steering in a copied recorded input; preserve all other recorded features and dt; not closed-loop gameplay
